assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: The impact map's '## Ambiguities' section explicitly flags 5 ambiguities: (1) 'Search should be faster' — no performance baseline or target SLA, (2) 'Results should be more relevant' — no relevance criteria or ranking specification, (3) 'Add filters' — no specification of filter types/fields/behavior, (4) 'Should be fast enough' — no quantitative performance target, (5) 'Don't break existing functionality' — no regression criteria defined. Each is labeled 'Assumption pending clarification' in impact-map.md lines 30-38.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Excluded Requirements' table (line 44): 'Better UI — Make it look nicer | No | Cannot be planned: no design mockups or Figma links are available, and no frontend repository is registered in the Repository Registry.' Also in summary-comment.md line 40: 'Better UI (Non-MVP): excluded from scope — no design mockups available, no frontend repository in the Repository Registry.'

assertion_results.text: Tasks still follow the task-description-template.md format despite ambiguous requirements

assertion_results.text: Tasks document assumptions where they fill in missing details, labeled as assumptions pending clarification
assertion_results.evidence: Each task has an explicit 'Assumption pending clarification:' label in its Description section. assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All included conventions use the prescribed rationale format. Task 1: 'Applies: convention has no file-type restriction (broadly applicable).' (correct for the Framework convention which has no file-type scope). Task 2: 'Applies: task modifies `modules/search/src/service/mod.rs` matching the convention's service .rs file scope.' and 'Applies: task modifies `tests/api/search.rs` matching the convention's test .rs file scope.' Task 3 includes 6 convention references, all with proper format: e.g., 'Applies: task modifies `modules/search/src/endpoints/mod.rs` matching the convention's handler .rs file scope.' No conventions are listed with 'Not applicable' annotations. No free-form prose rationales found.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 48: '**Priority:** Normal (propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md line 31: '**Priority:** Normal — propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks and epics'. Priority is 'Normal' (not 'Undefined') and is documented as propagated.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 49: '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 1.6.0 (propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks; no `fixVersion scope` configured in Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both")'. summary-comment.md line 32: '**Fix Versions:** RHTPA 1.6.0 — propagated from Feature TC-9002 to all created tasks and epics (no `fixVersion scope` configured in Jira Field Defaults; defaulted to "both")'. The Feature has fixVersions (RHTPA 1.6.0), no fixVersion scope is configured (defaults to 'both'), and propagation is documented.
